changes.comment: BREAKING: ai-assist sends Gemini's thinkingLevel. The @google-gemini:pro alias (the advanced tier and the frontier cascade) now resolves to gemini-4-argon (was gemini-3.1-pro-preview): thinking is always on there, and a generic effort is sent as thinkingLevel low/medium/high instead of a thinkingBudget; 'none' is sent as 'low', or refused under onUnsupported 'fail'. A new descriptor table, IAiProviderDescriptor.geminiThinkingLevels (read through resolveGeminiThinkingLevels), declares the level models and their levels: gemini-4-argon and gemini-4-carbon (low, medium, high), gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3.6-flash (minimal, low, medium, high). On those, 'none' becomes 'minimal' where listed, and an effort a model does not list is refused before the wire; every other Gemini model keeps the thinkingBudget wire unchanged. @google-gemini:flash-lite therefore sends 'none' as thinkingLevel minimal (it was degraded to a 1024 budget) and comes off thinkingRequiredModelPrefixes; gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-carbon and gemini-3-pro-preview go on it, so a generic 'none' no longer sends thinkingBudget 0 to gemini-3-pro-preview. IGeminiThinkingConfig gains thinkingLevel, validated by the new geminiThinkingLevel converter; a block that sets it together with thinkingBudget is refused, a level a declared model does not list is refused, and a later block's level replaces an earlier budget and vice versa. A caller-built resolvedThinking carrying both is refused by the Gemini streaming adapter. gemini-3.1-flash-lite (minimal through high; a -preview takes its rule), gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (minimal, high: a longer rule that outranks gemini-3.1-flash-lite's) and gemini-3-flash-preview are level models too. The 2.5 line takes budgets only (geminiThinkingLevelRejectedModelPrefixes, rejectsGeminiThinkingLevel): an explicit level there is refused. executeClientToolTurn refuses a caller-built Gemini thinking config as a Failure before streaming: geminiThinkingBudget 0 on a thinking-required model, a geminiThinkingLevel the model does not accept, or both fields together. gemini-4-argon is declared on maxOutputTokens (32768, the per-request non-streaming generateContent cap), GeminiThinkingModelNames (with gemini-4-carbon, gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3-pro-preview) and model-listing capability detection (chat, tools, vision, thinking).
